name: io.github.RedFoxxo/pounce
title: pounce (Targetprocess)
description: Read and manage Targetprocess cards by name, with team rules applied.

environmentVariables.name: TP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your instance, e.g. https://yourcompany.tpondemand.com (https only, except localhost)

environmentVariables.name: TP_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric id of the project for new cards that have no parent to inherit one from

environmentVariables.name: TP_DEFAULT_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric id of the team for new cards when none is given

environmentVariables.name: POUNCE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to expose, comma-separated: cards, raw, admin (empty: all three)
